title: Neurosphere Protocol - A Rapid Method for Isolation of Spheres In Vitro
author: Christopher Blackwood

steps.title: Prepare Embryos and Tools
steps.instruction: Establish breeding pairs of mice to obtain embryonic day 17 (E17) embryos, defining Day 0 as the day a vaginal plug is detected. Prepare sterile surgical tools, including scissors for decapitation, #5 forceps, and razor blades.

steps.title: Prepare and Prewarm Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the following buffers and media at the specified temperatures:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 ml of Hank’s buffer to each of two 10 cm petri plates and place on ice.
Add 5 ml Hank’s buffer to a 15 ml tube and place on ice.
Reserve 50 ml of room temperature Hank’s buffer.
Prewarm 10 ml of Hank’s-low BSA at 37 °C.
Prewarm 5 ml of Hank’s-high BSA at 37 °C.
Prewarm 10 ml of DMEM/F12 with serum at 37 °C.
Prewarm 5-15 ml of neurosphere media at 37 °C (amount based on number of desired wells).
Prewarm 2 ml of 0.25% trypsin/EDTA at 37 °C.

steps.title: Dissect Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Isolate the lateral ventricle from the E17 embryos using sterile technique.

substeps.instruction: Spray the abdomen with 70% ethanol, make an incision to expose the uterus, remove the uterus, and transfer it to an empty petri plate.
Remove embryos from the uterus, spray the desired number with 70% ethanol, and decapitate them.
Rinse each decapitated head in the first petri plate of Hank’s buffer, then transfer to the second petri plate of Hank’s buffer on ice.
Use forceps to remove the skin and skull; remove the brain and place it in an empty petri dish.
Separate the two hemispheres with a razor blade and place one half on its lateral surface.
Using a stereomicroscope, identify the T-shaped lateral ventricle on the medial surface and sequentially trim away surrounding brain tissue on all four sides using a razor blade or scalpel.
Transfer the dissected tissue into the 15 ml tube on ice (keep on ice if processing additional embryos).

steps.title: Dissociate Tissue into Single Cells
steps.instruction: Process the dissected tissue to create a uniform cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 300 RCF for 3 min to pellet tissue.
Aspirate supernatant and add 2 ml of pre-warmed trypsin/EDTA; incubate at 37 °C for 15 min with intermittent swirling.
Add 10 ml of room temperature Hank’s to the mixture and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min with intermittent swirling.
Centrifuge at 300 RCF for 3 min and remove the supernatant.
Aspirate supernatant and add 4 ml of Hank’s-low BSA.
Triturate gently and slowly ~10 times with an 18-gauge needle until chunks are uniform, avoiding bubbles/foam.
Triturate gently and slowly ~7-10 times with a 21-gauge needle until chunks are uniform.
Triturate ~4-5 times with a 23-gauge needle until the suspension is uniform.

steps.title: Purify and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Perform density gradient and washing steps to prepare cells for plating.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 ml of Hank’s-high BSA solution to a 15 ml tube; slowly layer the cell suspension to the bottom of the tube underneath the BSA solution using a 23-gauge needle.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells with 3 ml of prewarmed Hank’s-low BSA.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells in 5 ml of prewarmed DMEM/F12 with serum.
Incubate tubes for 2-4 hours at 37 °C to reduce bacterial contamination.

steps.title: Plate and Culture Neurospheres
steps.instruction: Seed the cells and maintain the culture until spheres form.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 1 ml of prewarmed neurosphere media.
Count cells with a hemocytometer and plate 10,000 cells in 250 μl volume per well of a 48-well plate (plate at least 8 wells).
Incubate at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.
At day 3 (when spheres form), add an additional 100 μl of neurosphere media to each well.

steps.title: Split Primary Neurospheres
steps.instruction: Passage the primary neurospheres after 5-7 days to maintain culture health.

substeps.instruction: Prewarm 10 ml of DMEM/F12 (without serum or antibiotics) at 37 °C.
Prewarm 2-15 ml of neurosphere media at 37 °C (based on desired wells).
Prewarm 1 ml of trypsin inhibitor at 37 °C.
Collect neurospheres from at least 8 wells and transfer to a 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 300 RCF for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and add prewarmed trypsin; incubate at 37 °C for 5-10 min depending on sphere size.
Add 1 ml of trypsin inhibitor solution and swirl for 15 seconds to inactivate trypsin.
Centrifuge at 300 RCF for 5 min.
Triturate gently and slowly ~7-10 times with a 21-gauge needle until chunks are uniform.
Triturate ~4-5 times with a 23-gauge needle until the suspension is uniform.
Centrifuge dissociated cells at 300 RCF for 5 min.
Count cells using a hemocytometer and plate 10,000 cells in 250 μl neurosphere media per well of a 48-well plate (at least 8 wells).
Incubate at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.
